title: Electron configuration
summary: Nitrogen: 1s² 2s² 2p³; singly occupy degenerate 2p orbitals before pairing.

title: Chlorine isotope mass spectrum
summary: Schematic atomic 35Cl / 37Cl peaks at approximately 3:1; not the Cl₂ molecular-ion spectrum.

title: Successive ionisation energies
summary: Needs sourced successive ionisation data and the shell-boundary jump.

title: Hydrogen emission line transitions
summary: Needs wavelength-calibrated Balmer lines linked to quantized levels.

title: VSEPR geometry
summary: Bent H₂O, approximately 104.5°; planar schematic omits the 3D lone-pair arrangement.

title: Ionic lattice
summary: A 2D slice of alternating ions; not the full six-coordinate 3D lattice.

title: σ / π orbital overlap
summary: Legacy overlap seed lacks orbital phase and symmetry fidelity; a domain-correct example is needed.

title: Bond dipole and molecular polarity
summary: Needs signed bond dipoles and a geometry-linked vector sum.

title: Limiting reagent
summary: Three H₂ plus one O₂ yield two H₂O with one H₂ left over; amounts are molecular ratios.

title: Mass ↔ amount ↔ particles
summary: For 18.0 g water using M = 18.0 g mol⁻¹: 1.00 mol and approximately 6.02 × 10²³ molecules.

title: Combustion data → empirical formula
summary: Needs a concrete mass dataset with conserved carbon and hydrogen.

title: Volumetric dilution
summary: Needs a calibrated flask sequence and explicit concentration/volume units.

title: Boyle’s law
summary: At fixed amount and temperature, PV is constant; ideal-gas model only.

title: Hydrogen bonding
summary: Dashed O···H interaction is distinct from a solid intramolecular O–H bond.

title: Pressure–temperature phase diagram
summary: Needs sourced phase boundaries with correctly signed solid–liquid slope.

title: NaCl dissolution and hydration shells
summary: Needs solvent orientation around each ion, not generic moving particles.

title: Reaction profile
summary: Compare the activation barrier with the reactant–product enthalpy difference.

title: Hess cycle
summary: ΔH(C→CO) = ΔH(C→CO₂) − ΔH(CO→CO₂), with all equations balanced.

title: Born–Haber cycle
summary: Needs all atomisation, ionisation, electron-affinity and lattice steps with an explicit lattice sign convention.

title: Gibbs energy
summary: Illustrative constant ΔH / ΔS model: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS; not a prediction across phase transitions.

title: First-order concentration decay
summary: A → products: [A] = [A]₀ exp(−kt), constant temperature and one first-order pathway.

title: Catalysed vs uncatalysed energy path
summary: Schematic alternative pathway has a lower barrier and unchanged endpoint enthalpies.

title: Maxwell–Boltzmann distribution
summary: Needs normalized distributions and an activation-energy tail; generic waves do not qualify.

title: Initial-rate table → reaction orders
summary: Needs an experimental table with independently varied reactants and stated uncertainty.

title: Dynamic equilibrium
summary: Forward and reverse rates become equal; concentrations need not be equal.

title: Equilibrium expression
summary: N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃; exponents follow stoichiometry in the concentration form.

title: Equilibrium composition shift
summary: Needs a mass-balanced equilibrium model and temperature-specific K.

title: Solubility product
summary: Needs ion product versus Ksp with dilution and stoichiometry preserved.

title: Strong acid–base titration curve
summary: 25.0 mL 0.100 M HCl titrated with 0.100 M NaOH at 25 °C; ideal activities.

title: Conjugate pairs
summary: NH₃ accepts a proton from H₂O, giving NH₄⁺ and OH⁻.

title: Buffer response
summary: Needs mass balance and equilibrium response to added acid/base.

title: Weak-acid titration
summary: Needs a calibrated curve, buffer region and pH = pKa at half equivalence.

title: Galvanic cell
summary: Zn anode oxidizes; electrons flow externally to the Cu cathode; salt bridge closes the ionic circuit.

title: Oxidation states
summary: In MnO₄⁻, four O at −2 require Mn at +7 to sum to −1.

title: Cell potential vs concentration
summary: Needs specified reaction quotient, electron number and temperature.

title: Copper electrolysis
summary: Needs charge integration, Faraday stoichiometry and electrode conditions.

title: Period 3
summary: Qualitative trend includes the Mg→Al and P→S exceptions; no fabricated measurements.

title: Group 2 hydroxide solubility trend
summary: Needs sourced solubility values and stated temperature.

title: Halogen displacement
summary: Needs actual species, observations and a balanced ionic equation.

title: Copper(II) ligand exchange
summary: Needs coordination number, charge and solvent-dependent color evidence.

title: Functional groups
summary: Condensed structural formulas compare alcohol and carboxylic acid groups.

title: Curly-arrow mechanism
summary: Legacy electron-pushing and bond-morph seeds lack a fully specified chemical reaction and charge accounting.

title: E/Z isomerism
summary: Needs correct priority assignment and explicit double-bond geometry.

title: Organic synthesis
summary: Needs a specific route with reagents, conditions and competing pathways.

title: Chromatography
summary: Rf = distance traveled by spot / distance traveled by solvent front, both from the baseline.

title: IR spectrum
summary: Needs a sourced spectrum with wavenumber axis and labeled absorption convention.

title: NMR spectrum → structure
summary: Needs sourced chemical shifts, integration and splitting; no invented spectrum.

title: Mass spectrum
summary: Needs a specific spectrum and chemically valid fragment masses.
